lore: A thin book about very thin slabs.
use: The Simple Slabs Guide explains half slabs, the side half slab and how to cut them. Craft it shapeless from a book and a stone slab.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.

lore: {name}: a half slab standing upright, 4 pixels thin.
use: Right-click on a block side: it stands against that side. Each further click there or on its open face adds a layer; 2 layers = side slab, 4 = full cell. 1:1 from the half slab, or cut 2 from a slab. Breaking drops one per layer.
secret: On the top of a block it leans on the far wall of the cell, the way you look.

use: Places in the clicked cell layer; the same half slab fills the free layer at the click. Cut 2 from a slab, 4 from the block; 2 craft back, 1 crafts into a side half slab. Breaking drops one per layer.
secret: Four layers fit into one cell, in any order: 0-4 plus 12-16 pixels is just layers 1 and 4. Sand and gravel half slabs fall, copper ones age.
